evals.prompt: Run enterprise discover after the repo profile changes.
evals.expected_output: Discover must regenerate repo-local overlays, write an overlay manifest with generated_at, generator version, source hashes, and profile/trap/best-practice hashes, then keep portable and machine-local state separated.
assertions: Requires overlay generation from the current profile.
Keeps machine-local facts out of committed portable state.

evals.prompt: A repo profile exists but commands and source-of-truth docs are contradicted by the current repository.
evals.expected_output: Discover must treat the profile as stale, refresh it from current source, regenerate overlays, and block warm delivery until the profile and overlays are trustworthy.
assertions: Blocks delivery when source-of-truth docs or commands are unknown.
